scope: Authored src JavaScript inventory and runtime efficiency review. All modules were inventoried and their exports/imports/hot-path patterns checked; deeper implementation/caller review focused on rendering, HUD, audio, asset caches, scenery, input and pickup/combat counters. This is not a proof of complete semantic equivalence or a full native-game comparison. Storage/settings schema, main loader and server/build work belong to the parent audit. Original-source generated evidence was not changed.
benefits: Unchanged HUD glyphs retain cached layout and GPU buffers while every required draw still occurs; cache is bounded per string and disposed with HUD.
Native render transforms write existing matrices directly; shadow conversion occurs at captured endpoints rather than every unlocked frame.
Five effect renderers share packed ARGB byte writes without temporary per-vertex arrays.
Pickup/projectile active counters no longer allocate filtered arrays; original per-pickup recount timing remains.
Moved unchanged NPC finish timer recorder into results and re-exported the prior AI API, removing the menu persistence dependency on AI/items/trig modules without changing save fields or timers.

validation.note: First run included five new render-efficiency cases. Second run repeats those five and adds the packed stream/weather case, while validating the subsequent shared color-write/count changes. Original HUD/shadow/mirror source was unchanged after its first pass.

hudModesBrowser.scope: Existing focused HUD integration check across four race modes, notices, portrait and combat events; no complete races.
